activities.title: An imaginary window
activities.description: Imagine a peaceful view, with no need to look at your screen.

steps.text: Rest your gaze comfortably away from the screen. Imagine a window overlooking somewhere peaceful. Picture one colour and one sound. You may simply rest instead.

accessibleAlternatives: Read the text instead of using narration.
For movement, remain seated or imagine the movement without performing it.
activities.author: AppBreak project contributors
